messages:
michelle_mktg: Morning. Were finalizing the keynote demo and need a concise perf package for the interactive slide: streaming + function-calls scenario. Requesting coldstart vs warmed workers, quantized vs fp16, and a small 3b baseline. Need p50/p75/p90/p95/p99 and per-chunk streaming latencies, plus function-call end-to-end latency. Also want a tiny synthetic prompt pack (no customer data) we can embed in the deck.

sam_runtime: OK. Can you confirm traffic shape? steady QPS or human-typing pattern? Also, which infra image (cuda/toolkit) should we record in README?

michelle_mktg: Human-typing shape preferred. 4 simulated users, each issues 3 short prompts (~30 tokens) then one long probe (1.5k tokens). Streaming chunk size ~128 tokens or 200ms whichever hits first. Record infra: cuda-12.1, cuDNN-9, driver-535.

ow_devx: small correction: my harness simulates typing at variable inter-char intervals (rand 30-120ms) and supports toggling chunk thresholds. I'll paste a minimal harness payload to use.

ow_devx: ```json
{
  "users":4,
  "turns_short":3,
  "short_avg_tokens":30,
  "long_probe_tokens":1500,
  "typing_delay_ms_range":[30,120],
  "stream_chunk_tokens":128,
  "function_call":true
}
```

sam_runtime: Nice. We'll run quantized 3b and 7b first as a smoke set, then fp16 7b for comparison. Can we also capture GV memory peaks and per-request GPU-ms? We'll produce perf.jsonl and a small CSV summary.

maya_eval: I'll prepare a 30-case function-call fidelity suite (schema matching + missing-arg checks) and a few coherence checks for the long probe. I'll output a pass/fail table so marketing can see if any variant regressed. ETA 18:00 PT today.

michelle_mktg: Great. Please include a short README snippet that lists the exact CLI, env vars (CUDA, LD_LIBRARY_PATH), and the harness commit SHA. Also include a short heatmap image (png) showing warmup vs first-request coldstart.

benchbot: Run scheduled: id=rb-2026-3530012345-A, targets=[open-3b-quant,open-7b-quant], profile=typing_stream, expected=22m. Artifacts will be uploaded to s3://redwood-bench/3530012345_A/ when done.

sam_runtime: We'll add per-chunk latency columns (chunk_index, chunk_send_ts, chunk_recv_ts) to perf.jsonl so you can compute per-chunk pXX. Also will include function-call latency measured from initial request to final function payload emission and separate kernel-level timings if available.

ow_devx: Quick note: to make samples press-safe I'll synthesize names/ids and remove any natural-language content that resembles customer support transcripts. Will attach sanitized_prompts.json.

maya_eval: If we see function-call schema mismatches on quantized variants, I'll flag with the offending prompt ids for targeted repro.

sam_runtime: Kicking off smoke now. Will post a short summary and artifacts link in this thread. If maintenance window hits we'll pause and pick up after.

michelle_mktg: Thanks team. Tag me (@michelle_mktg) when artifacts land. If any variant fails the eval, we'll default demo to 3b quantized and note the trade-off on slide copy. :rocket:
